description: Check a draft App Store listing before it goes to App Store Connect. It reports character limits per field, keyword-field room lost to spaces, repeats, words already in the name or subtitle, the brand and filler words, name/subtitle repeats, Apple product names and price words, whether the text is in the locale's language and script, and which of the app's tracked keywords the draft leaves out. Writes nothing; pass only the fields you want checked.

country.description: country whose tracked keywords to check coverage against, e.g. us (defaults to the app's first country)

keywords.description: keyword field, comma-separated, up to 100 characters

locale.description: listing locale, e.g. en-US, de-DE, ja

name: validate_listing
